mapper.select:
select count(*) as totalTradeCount, sum(case when t.profit_pct > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as winCount, sum(case when t.profit_pct < 0 then 1 else 0 end) as lossCount, ifnull(avg(t.profit_pct), 0) as avgProfitPct, ifnull(max(t.profit_pct), 0) as maxProfitPct, ifnull(min(t.profit_pct), 0) as maxLossPct from t_trial_trade_record t
t.profit_pct is not null and t.trade_datetime >= #{startTime} and t.trade_datetime < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and t.owner = #{owner}

select date_format(r.review_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, r.emotion_temp as emotion, ifnull(wr.winRate, 0) as winRate from t_trial_daily_review r left join ( select date_format(date_add(trade_datetime, interval -1 day), '%Y-%m-%d') as td, owner, sum(case when profit_pct > 0 then 1 else 0 end) / count(*) * 100 as winRate from t_trial_trade_record
profit_pct is not null and trade_datetime >= #{startTime} and trade_datetime < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
group by date_format(date_add(trade_datetime, interval -1 day), '%Y-%m-%d'), owner ) wr on wr.td = date_format(r.review_date, '%Y-%m-%d') and wr.owner = r.owner
r.emotion_temp is not null and r.review_date >= #{startTime} and r.review_date <= #{endTime} and r.owner = #{owner}
order by r.review_date asc
